## About
Custom Cap & Tire sells and services tires in Roseville. Adam McGath is the owner. He and the crew handle retreads, commercial, passenger and light truck, industrial, trailer and skid steer tires.
One reviewer called after a dump truck blew a tire and now refers his trucking buddies here. Another drives for Patrick Miller Roll-off and says they have a very good relationship with the shop.
Rated 4.8 on Google from 90 reviews.

## Services
- Passenger & Light Truck: Tires sold and serviced for cars, pickups and light trucks.
- Tire repair: Adam and the crew repair your tire and get you back on the road as quick as they can.
- Tire rebalancing: One reviewer says they broke the bead, rotated the tire on the rim and rebalanced to cut down on weights.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of tires do you sell and service?
A: Retreads, commercial, passenger and light truck, industrial, trailer and skid steer tires.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:30 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

## What customers say
- "These guys did a great job! Actually took the time to minimize the amount of weights used to balance the tires by breaking the bead and rotating the tire on the rim and rebalancing them.
